programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Montana's Tom and Nancy Oar prepare for the long winter ahead; Jake Herak battles dense fog and mountain terrain on foot in pursuit of elk; Josh Kirk attempts to move a 150-year-old log cabin to the heart of his bison ranch in Wyoming.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Tom Oar reunites with Sean McAfee to set his winter trap line, but miles of grueling terrain put the veteran trapper's endurance to the test; in Alaska, Martha and Ellie Tansy embark on an off-road expedition to new hunting grounds.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Kidd and Harry Youren hunt a black bear that tore up their camp; Martha and Elli Tansy finally have a bull moose in their sights; Tom Oar educates 9-year-old Hank McAfee on the traditional skills of trapping and skinning.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Tom Oar struggles with heart problems but refuses to give up his way of life; Jake Herak and Anika Ward have added five new puppies to their pack; Martha and Elli Tansy pack hundreds of pounds of meat; Mike Horstman hunts fox for their fur.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Tom receives a diagnosis for his heart condition; Jake hunts coyotes at night; Eustace rebuilds the road to Turtle Island; Mike hunts goats; Josh and Bonnie each harvest a deer; Kidd and Harry build a heavy-duty scow boat from scratch.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Mike climbs Kodiak Island's highest peaks to take down a mountain goat, then rappels down sheer cliffs to bring home his harvest. Martha and Elli use their tracked vehicle to scout new hunting grounds.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Kidd and Harry Youren use explosives to battle a deep freeze to protect their cattle's drinking supply; Jake Herak's young pups learn a big lesson in lion hunting; Josh Kirk takes aim at a pack of coyotes messing with his bison.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Jake and the pups make a grisly discovery in new territory; Josh rebuilds an antique windmill to power his outpost cabin; Kidd and Harry brave raging rapids to retrieve a capsized canoe; Martha and Elli clear the road of fallen trees.
